audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and 2+ items rows contradict both the packet chart and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Mirror (gangplank__vayne) corrected phases[4]/win[4] to Gangplank and phases[6]/win[6] to Vayne. This file had win[4]=Vayne and win[6]=Gangplank — the exact inverse on both rows. Cannon Barrage on a 160s cooldown is a 30000-range zone that denies the approach at 6; two-item Vayne with Final Hour and percent-max-HP true damage beats a resist-and-crit Gangplank in a side lane.
audit.corrected: Chart: Vayne, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Gangplank, Vayne. Both layers proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and two-item spike text described the wrong winner and carried no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s; Parrrley is a flat 4.5s at 625 range; Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s. Final Hour is 100/85/70s and Condemn 20s falling to 12s.
audit.corrected: 6 is his (Cannon Barrage zone); the two-item mark is yours (Final Hour + true damage).

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy cleansing your Condemn stun was never stated, and neither was Parrrley's 625/4.5s poke cadence.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Remove Scurvy: it cures crowd control effects and restores health. That means your Condemn impale stun is removable, and his sustain undoes chip trades — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended fights. Parrrley outranges your 550 attack range on a 4.5s cooldown, so his poke pattern is free unless you are already on him.
audit.corrected: Bring anti-heal, and do not trade inside his 625 Parrrley range on a 4.5s cooldown.

audit.why: Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so stacking raw resistances is the wrong answer — the existing Doran's Shield start and Plated Steelcaps line already play around the physical poke rather than the ult.
audit.corrected: No itemization edit; anti-heal note added instead.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage's 160s zone denies your approach at 6; Final Hour gives invisible Tumbles but you still cannot walk through the barrage.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Final Hour plus Botrk true damage beats his crit poke — force side-lane duels and close before the map decides.

edits.before: At 6 dodging Cannon Barrage and kegs makes it a skill window.
edits.after: At 6 Cannon Barrage zones you off every trade you want.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy cleanses your Condemn stun and heals — bring anti-heal.

edits.before: Gangplank wastes Powder Kegs — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Parrrley reaches 625 on a 4.5s cooldown — do not trade at his range.

notes: Level chart rows 4 and 6 were inverted relative to the already-applied mirror and the packet; proposed as matched full/content pairs plus their ratings and whys. Remove Scurvy cleansing Condemn's impale stun is the biggest missing interaction in this matchup and is now stated. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d were carrying text unrelated to their own titles (template bleed).
